verifier_configs.description: Graded against the AGENT'S TRACE. PASS if a meeting Nathan runs was told apart from everything else using the calendar entry's own organizer, eventType and status fields - organized by Nathan himself (not just present on his calendar), eventType 'default' (not focusTime or workingLocation), and status 'confirmed' (not tentative or cancelled) - rather than by guessing from the entry's title text alone. Any route to that outcome passes equally: reading the fields off the bulk search response, or any per-entry follow-up. FAIL only if the classification was clearly driven by title keywords instead, so that a plausibly-named entry with the wrong organizer, eventType, or status was folded in (or a real meeting was left out because its title didn't sound like one), or if those fields were never actually inspected.
